panels.description: At night inside and outside GODARAZ, indistinct local testers stand behind the lanes. Pinty connects a tractor jumper to the alley wiring while separate temporary service equipment remains at the threshold. Keep upper-right clear.
The power cuts mid-frame. Tractor light enters the dark alley. The Dude holds a finished buffalo-milk White Russian at the counter. Keep upper-left counter space clear.
A small video screen shows Walter’s intense face and laminated rulebook, surrounded by the dark alley. Keep the screen’s top edge clear.
At the GODARAZ threshold beneath the oversized z, two apologetic goons speak with the worried power contractor beside the temporary service equipment. Keep the wall clear.

items.speaker: WALTER
items.text: A power cut is not a philosophy. It is a ruling.
